notes: Parity runs pending. Both sides send the same request: upstream's OpenAI Responses call through LiteLLM (gpt-6-luna, thinking level high, no web search, no retries); TY2025 attaches the PDFs and streams with upstream's 14,400 s timeout. Original side: unmodified upstream at fdfe0db via parity/run_original.sh, which runs upstream's CLI in a private export of that commit. Harbor side: taxcalcbench-direct@1.0.0 via run_taxcalcbench_parity.yaml, with LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True as upstream sets it. Subset: the 20 cases in parity/parity_cases.txt. Order: 6-case sanity check on both sides (parity/sanity_cases.txt), one full run on both sides, then runs 2 and 3. parity/collect_parity.py uses the same arithmetic on both sides, computes mean and sample SEM from the raw runs and applies the range-overlap check. A failed generation is left unscored on both sides (Harbor: listed with its error type; original: a status per case plus upstream's log) and can be attempted again with the same settings; the files of earlier attempts are kept. dataset_pr and parity_pr are null until those PRs exist. In adapter_pr, harbor-framework/adapters#126 is the closed first copy of this PR; the work moved to harbor-index/adapters#27.
